Comment: Very fun in shortest mode.
Great as Reverse Mode too.

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: Nice easy puzzle. Good case coverage. Suitable for all modes.
Seeing as a week has gone by without suggestions for improvement, I have decided to change the status to Ready. If there is any specific errors, please notify me!

Goal
* Please change "integer(s)" to "digit(s)".

* The Goal doesn't state what to do when the digit is exactly 5.

Output
* Please change "applying the changes to" to "converting".

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Cases
* Please remove the trailing newlines from the input for:
  • Validator 3
  • Validator 6

* Please modify all the validators so that the output is slightly different from their corresponding tests.

* Please modify the input of Test 3 to start with a 0.

* Please modify Test/Validator 2, 4 and 5 so that the output starts with one or more 1s.

* Please modify the input of Test 6 and Validator 6 to start with more than one 0.

* Please insert a pair of cases where the length of [[n]] is around 35, the output consists of 0s only, and [[n]] consists of all the digits from 0 to 4.

* Please insert a pair of cases where the length of [[n]] is around 45, the output consists of 1s only, and [[n]] consists of all the digits from 5 to 9.

Thanks.

Thanks for the feedback! 

I think I have addressed the points, though in the statement it reads: 
'Given a string of digit(s) n, convert any digit below 5 to 0, and any digit greater than or equal to 5 to 1.'

Goal
* Please change "digit(s)" to "digits".

* Please change "any digit" to "all digits" (twice).

Cases
* Validator 7: Please add one digit to the input so that there is one more 0 in the output.

* Validator 8: Please add one digit to the input so that there is one more 1 in the output.

Thanks.
Thanks for the suggestions! I believe I have addressed all the issues.
